verdict.rationale: Latham's IP Litigation page explicitly lists trade secret disputes as a practice area with Chambers-ranked recognition, and Executive Compensation/Employment page covers employment-related disputes broadly, but there is no specific evidence of dedicated confidentiality-program counseling or employee-mobility (non-compete/restrictive covenant) work products. missing for 10: dedicated trade-secret confidentiality program materials, employee-mobility/non-compete dispute specifics, case studies or client matters demonstrating trade-secret litigation outcomes.
